name: Pittsburgh
living: the river behind the wall ripples with the golden sunset reflection shimmering on it
the yellow suspension bridge's lamps glow and twinkle, a slow glint sliding along its cables
headlights crawl across the bridge deck now and then (sprite)
downtown tower and brick building windows flicker on one by one as the light fades
the pyramid-topped tower's spire light blinks slowly (aircraft light)
the baseball video boards on both sides spin their pixel ball gently
golden sunset clouds drift slowly across the sky
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe, moths drifting through their cones
a small flock of birds crosses the amber sky over the hills now and then
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
